snippet.title: Mysteries of Rodion — Official Gameplay Demo Teaser | Mystery Visual Novel
snippet.description:
Welcome to Mysteries of Rodion — an atmospheric supernatural visual novel filled with secrets, strange artifacts, and dark mysteries.

Angela finds herself drawn into the secrets of Rodion’s mysterious antique shop, where unusual objects seem to choose their own owners. Investigate missing artifacts, uncover the truth behind a series of strange deaths, solve puzzles, and discover the hidden stories of the shop’s collection.

Every artifact has a story.
Every mystery leaves a trace.
And some secrets were never meant to be revealed.

🔹 Explore a mysterious antique shop
🔹 Investigate supernatural events
🔹 Examine artifacts and uncover their stories
🔹 Solve puzzles and gather clues
🔹 Make choices with lasting consequences
🔹 Fill your personal hub with discovered items

Play the demo and add Mysteries of Rodion to your Steam Wishlist:



Developed by Volganka Games.

5% of the game’s sales will be donated to a rabbit shelter.

#MysteriesOfRodion #VisualNovel #IndieGame
